news.raw_snippet:
Waters AI Link currently brings together capabilities supporting quantitative acquisition and processing workflows. These tools enable activities such as creating and editing sample lists, working with acquisition methods, assigning instruments, accessing analytical results, and generating reports. As coverage expands, the goal is a connected, end-to-end experience from method development through acquisition, processing, and result retrieval.

## Designed to make everyday work simpler [...] Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people interact with software. However, in the lab, innovation must do more than make technology easier to use, it must also support scientific confidence, protect access to data, and fit within established governance. Waters AI Link is designed for that reality, providing a conversational connection to waters\_connect Software that helps lab teams turn natural-language requests into controlled actions across their analytical workflows. [...] Lab software supports highly specialized work, but routine tasks can still involve moving through multiple applications, menus, and setup steps. Creating acquisition methods, building sample lists, assigning instruments, submitting work, and retrieving results all require time and attention. For experienced users, that can mean repetitive administration, whereas for newer analysts it can create a steep learning curve and greater dependence on expert colleagues.

news.raw_snippet:
“Go be a founder” is not an answer to a broken hiring pipeline, and neither is “go be a health aide.” But the underlying patterns are worth taking seriously. Young people should be focusing on durable jobs that are AI-resilient — the ones that require them to show up, be responsible for their decisions and foster human connections.

The bottom of the corporate ladder is breaking. Yet the ceiling on what a 23-year-old can achieve has never been higher.

Most US startups before Series B need the middle column. If your product calls OpenAI, Anthropic or Google models and your team will not change the weights, you are hiring an AI engineer.

Hire an ML engineer only when the model itself is the product, and an AI agent developer only when agents fill most of your roadmap.

Anthropic's engineering team draws the line between the two kinds of system this way: [...] Matt Li is a tech-driven entrepreneur with deep expertise in global talent strategy, digital experience optimization, e-commerce, and Web3 innovation. He is the Co-Founder of Second Talent, a US-based company that connects businesses with top-tier tech professionals worldwide. Since launching the company in 2024, Matt has led its growth by leveraging technology to streamline remote hiring and scale distributed teams. With a background spanning product, operations, and innovation, Matt brings a [...] AI engineer topped LinkedIn's list of the fastest-growing jobs in the US in both 2025 and 2026. The title spreads because it is loose: one startup means a model trainer, the next means someone who wires Claude or GPT into a checkout flow.
